author: Pecos Hank
description:
Every Type of Tornado Explained — From Wedges to Bird Farts

How many different types of tornadoes are there? Over the years, I've managed to document every type of tornado—from massive wedges and landspouts to satellite tornadoes, anticyclonic tornadoes, QLCS tornadoes, and multiple-vortex tornadoes. 

In this video, we'll explore how tornadoes are classified, including the two broad categories of mesocyclonic and non-mesocyclonic tornadoes, and how their behavior, location within a storm, and appearance can vary dramatically.
